title: Two-star general furious at doctor's alien bodies question

tellings.quote: goes well there was this a two star general that came in here uh about six months ago and I did that same thing and he got furious with me

plain: A doctor near Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio says a two-star general who came to see him got furious when the doctor asked him about alien bodies. The scientist John Blitch, formerly of DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, tells Michels the doctor told him this after Blitch asked the same kind of question, about six months after the general's visit. The general's anger is told as a hint that the question touched something real.
